quest.guildmark.clear.title: Clear the Outskirts
quest.guildmark.clear.desc: Defeat %s hostile mobs within %s blocks of this board.

quest.guildmark.story.farmer.fetch.0: The harvest came in short this year.
quest.guildmark.story.farmer.fetch.1: I promised the baker more than my fields can give.
quest.guildmark.story.farmer.fetch.2: Crows got half the crop. Help me make up the rest.
quest.guildmark.story.butcher.fetch.0: The smokehouse is empty and the feast is in three days.
quest.guildmark.story.butcher.hunt.0: Wolves have been taking our sheep at night.
quest.guildmark.story.fisherman.fetch.0: The fish aren't biting for me. Maybe they'll bite for you.
quest.guildmark.story.fisherman.fetch.1: The market wants fish, and my nets are torn.
quest.guildmark.story.fisherman.hunt.0: Something drags men off the docks after dark.
quest.guildmark.story.shepherd.fetch.0: My loom is idle and orders keep coming.
quest.guildmark.story.shepherd.hunt.0: Wolves have been circling the flock.
quest.guildmark.story.fletcher.fetch.0: Archers need arrows, and arrows need parts.
quest.guildmark.story.fletcher.fetch.1: A big order came from the next village over.
quest.guildmark.story.fletcher.hunt.0: I want their bones for bows. Don't ask.
quest.guildmark.story.leatherworker.fetc: The tannery is quiet without hides.
I've been asked for a saddle and have nothing to make it from.
quest.guildmark.story.librarian.fetch.0: The library is running out of pages to write on.
quest.guildmark.story.librarian.fetch.1: A scholar is coming and I have nothing to show them.
quest.guildmark.story.librarian.hunt.0: A witch stole a book of mine. I want it back, and her gone.
quest.guildmark.story.cartographer.fetch: Maps don't draw themselves, and I'm out of supplies.
The far roads need charting before the snows.
quest.guildmark.story.cleric.fetch.0: The temple needs supplies for its rites.
quest.guildmark.story.cleric.fetch.1: Sick folk come to me, and my shelves are bare.
quest.guildmark.story.cleric.hunt.0: The restless dead keep wandering into town. Put them to rest.
quest.guildmark.story.armorer.fetch.1: The guards need new armor and I'm short on iron.
quest.guildmark.story.armorer.hunt.0: Test my armor's worth on something that bites back.
Good steel starts with good iron.
quest.guildmark.story.weaponsmith.hunt.0: Raiders have been seen on the roads. Bring their heads.
quest.guildmark.story.toolsmith.fetch.0: Every miner in town has worn out a pick this month.
quest.guildmark.story.mason.fetch.1: The town hall needs a new floor.
quest.guildmark.story.village.hunt.0: Monsters have been spotted near the fields.
quest.guildmark.story.village.hunt.1: Folks are afraid to walk home after dark.
quest.guildmark.story.village.clear.0: The outskirts aren't safe anymore. Make them safe.
quest.guildmark.story.village.clear.1: Every night more of them gather at the edge of town.
quest.guildmark.story.village.fetch.0: The village is preparing for a festival and needs help.

quest.guildmark.story.village.deliver.0: My sister lives a long way off. Please bring her this.
quest.guildmark.story.village.deliver.1: The elders want word sent to our neighbours.
quest.guildmark.story.village.escort.0: A traveller needs safe passage to the next village.
quest.guildmark.story.village.escort.1: My cousin is moving away and the roads aren't safe.
quest.guildmark.story.village.champion.0: Something with a name has been killing our livestock.
quest.guildmark.story.village.champion.1: A monster wearing armour was seen at the treeline. It's no ordinary beast.
quest.guildmark.story.cartographer.deliv: These charts must reach the next village's mapmaker.
Survey notes, sealed. Don't get them wet.
quest.guildmark.story.cartographer.escor: My apprentice is off to map new lands. See them there safely.
A rare book, on loan to a colleague. Handle it gently.
quest.guildmark.story.cleric.champion.0: An undead lord walks near the village. End it.
quest.guildmark.story.weaponsmith.champi: A raider captain has been testing our defences.
quest.guildmark.story.armorer.champion.0: An armoured skeleton keeps picking off our guards.
